0d6e004884274f819408e22340ab82a0.reasoning: The complete pinned F# row names a programming-language classifier and lists .fs, .fsi and .fsx. All eight catalog specimens are implementation files. Their declarations, expressions and source forms identify F# even where they use .NET serialization and test APIs. The historical language working draft treats .fsi and .fsx as signature and script input kinds of F#, and the independently pinned Ionide grammars identify the corresponding highlighting scopes. Because .fs is shared with Forth, GLSL and Filterscript, the suffix by itself cannot establish this identity. The separate FsLex and Paket scopes do not extend the F# row.

specimen_notes.JsonSerializer.fs: A class and type extension use optional F# arguments, overrides, inherited implementation and .NET interoperability attributes.
specimen_notes.JsonWriter.fs: An F# interface implementation uses mutable state, conditional forms and calls to imported JSON writer methods.
specimen_notes.PerformanceTesters.fs: F# class definitions inherit test harness objects and use external NUnit and PerfUtil metadata. Test harness dependencies do not broaden the language row.
specimen_notes.PerformanceTests.fs: An F# test module includes attributes, records, union applications, comprehensions and quotations with async examples. The corpus does not establish a particular compiler revision.
